candidates.change_summary: Replace pot += msg.value with pot = 0 after the require, so pot resets before any win/loss logic.
Change pot += msg.value to pot += 1, so the pot accumulates a different amount than the sent ticket amount.
Delete the line pot = 0 inside the if block so the pot is not reset after a win, leaving residual value.
Replace pot - FEE_AMOUNT in the transfer with pot to transfer the full pot instead of deducting the fee, changing the final pot value (0 vs previous pot).
Move pot = 0 to before the if block and delete the original, so pot resets even on loss, altering observable pot state after loss.
Replace TICKET_AMOUNT with FEE_AMOUNT in the require statement so play accepts a different msg.value.
Replace 'pot += msg.value' with 'pot = msg.value' so the pot does not accumulate across calls.
Replace 'block.timestamp' with 'block.number' to change the randomness source, altering win probability.
Replace '% 2' with '% 3' so the range of random changes, drastically altering the condition outcome.
Replace 'if (random == 0)' with 'if (random != 0)' inverting the win condition.
Replace 'FEE_AMOUNT' with 'TICKET_AMOUNT' in the bank transfer inside the if block, changing the fee amount.
Replace 'payable(msg.sender).transfer(pot - FEE_AMOUNT)' with 'payable(msg.sender).transfer(pot)' so the winner receives the full pot.
Delete the line 'pot = 0;' so the pot is not reset after a win, affecting subsequent play outcomes.
Delete the require statement so play can be called with any msg.value.
